insights.summary: When the AI Voice Agent transfers to a live agent, the details it collected do not arrive, so callers repeat themselves.
insights.quote: When it transfers to a live agent, whatever it collected from the caller doesn't show up on our end.

insights.summary: Invoca offline call conversions reach Google Ads one to three days after the call, so Smart Bidding optimizes on incomplete data.
insights.quote: We compared the call dates to the conversion date column in Google Ads and there's a two to three day gap.
